name: Automatic Sanitary Pad & Diaper Disposer
desc: Compact, stainless steel electrical incinerator that cleanly converts sanitary waste into sterile ash.
overview: The Automatic Sanitary Pad & Diaper Disposer provides an eco-friendly and highly effective solution for hygiene waste management in schools, offices, hospitals, and homes. Using fully electric high-temperature incineration, it converts used sanitary napkins and baby diapers into a minimal amount of sterile, non-hazardous ash. Its premium stainless steel construction ensures durability and rust resistance in high-humidity washroom environments.
features: Complete Hygiene & Odor Control: Instant thermal disposal eliminates foul odors, prevents bacterial growth, and removes health risks associated with exposed waste.
Compact & Space-Saving: Designed with a small footprint to easily fit into individual washroom cubicles or tight utility spaces.
Durable Stainless Steel Body: Long-lasting SS build resists moisture, corrosion, and wear in high-humidity restroom environments.
Clog-Free Plumbing Protection: Prevents costly drainage blockages and pipe damage caused by improper flushing of pads and diapers.
Eco-Friendly Waste Reduction: Drastically reduces solid waste volume by turning bulky sanitary items into a minimal amount of non-hazardous ash.
Cost-Effective Solution: Provides high-end hygiene automation and durability at an accessible ₹10,000 price point.
